title: 4-Hour Guided Off-Road Adventure to Wild Horses and Old Saloon
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is an off-road Jeep experience of checking out the hidden gems of the desert wasteland. From petroglyphs, haunted saloons from the 1900's, to a multitude of wildlife this experience has it all! 

At the end of this journey you'll come out with knowledge of a forgotten time, new friends and a hell of an adrenaline rush! This is something for everyone, and we can't wait to share it with you!

*This is a guided tour with an experienced driver, if interested in driving the Jeep please message us and we can discuss different rates and procedure. Bring your friends out on this this wonderful adventure!
